rationales.F03: Acute urinary retention is a common symptom in Transverse Myelitis and less common in other conditions.
rationales.F06: Marked paraparesis of the lower limbs is a strong indicator of spinal cord involvement, which is typical of Transverse Myelitis and Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder.
rationales.F07: Hyperreflexia with sustained clonus in the lower extremities is a strong indicator of spinal cord involvement, which is typical of Transverse Myelitis and Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder.
rationales.F12: Multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions in the periventricular and periaqueductal regions are typical of Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis and less common in other conditions.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of marked paraparesis, hyperreflexia, and multiple bilateral symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions in the periventricular and periaqueductal regions decided it.
